cases.public_facts:
Facts:
Henry and Amir Evans (hereinafter the Debtors) filed for bankruptcy on Tuesday, November 19th, 2024. Ownership of the cordless electric drill with interchangeable bits and wall charger, priced at $125.00, is claimed by Henry and Amir. The Glock 19 Gen5 9mm pistol with two magazines, owned by Henry and Amir Evans, holds a monetary value of $575.00. The Debtors own a two-bedroom cottage (primary dwelling) with lofted sleeping area, and 900 square feet of interior space worth $210,500.00.
